text: I had kept the old coat for years, long after it had become too small to wear. When I finally slipped my hand into the pocket, I found a faded cinema ticket. It brought back not the film, whose story had vanished, but the friend who had sat beside me. For a moment, the coat felt like a doorway to that time. I placed the ticket carefully in a drawer, then donated the coat, grateful for what it had helped me remember.
